summary: Hyundai ABS Funding, LLC and Hyundai Auto Receivables Trust 2026-C filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus for a $2,066,160,000 auto-loan ABS offering, split across Class A-1 through Class C notes with coupons of 4.193% to 5.46% and a SOFR+0.37% floater, all maturing 2027-2034. This is a routine term securitization shelf takedown secured by retail installment contracts and vehicle collateral, not a special situation. Credit enhancement includes subordination, a reserve account, excess interest and overcollateralization. Watch pricing, retention and spread tightening; no deal-risk arbitrage angle applies.
